notes.title: Huge bugfix and polishing update
notes.content:
I've updated The Communist Dogifesto to address almost all the player feedback I've received since the initial release. This means a significantly more polished experience, more interesting enemies, fewer bugs, better balance, and better help messages. Here is a mostly complete list of changes:


 Added in-game music, including ambient soundtrack and combat music
 Added quicksave/quickload feature Added a custom in-game cursor instead of using the system cursor
 Added more, better, bigger tutorial text
 Added stats screen at the end of the game, which displays how many datapads and schematics the player found, out of how many there are in the game, and some other spoilery data
 Added by-lines to datapads to make the story being told a bit more clear, and made the text slightly less grim to better fit the tone of the game
 Added an in-game screenshot control, and some hardcoded keys for taking nicer screenshots: F10 = Toggle HUD, F11 = Toggle held item, Scroll Lock = Rewind skybox
 Improved precision of target selection for some mechanics (Picking up items around corners/ledges is now a lot easier)
 Re-balanced weapons, tech upgrades, item placement, tech upgrade placement, enemy placement, enemy behavior, ...
 Made enemy behavior more intelligent when the player is visible but no path is found to reach them.
 Made fire slightly less dangerous (but still dangerous!)
 Made the central spire in the power station cause damage when the player is too close (radiation hazard)
 Made the flashlight time-limited. Also softened flashlight brightness, and widened the beam slightly.
 Replaced lunch wraps with nutrient paste
 Reduced height of handrails
 Fixed held item clipping through level geometry
 Fixed bug causing hit physics objects (stools, barrels) to remain stationary
 Fixed bug causing enemies to pathfind through closed doors in some situations
 Fixed bug causing enemies to not respond to collisions with the player
 Many more tiny fixes and tweaks
